text:
Maria K: Quick status check on the HSM/KMS gating checklist for SOC2 fieldwork next month. Can infra/product/security owners confirm milestones and blockers? High-level items: audit-log ingestion, key rotation e2e, HSM attestation doc, vendor CA cert, export-control signoff.

Alex P: Infra update — KMS key rotation tests are green in staging (rotation + automated rollback). Still blocked on vendor CA cert for mgmt plane; vendor legal replied but timeline unclear. Also need a firewall rule: allow 10.12.0.0/22 -> HSM mgmt.

Samir R: Audit side — retention + integrity looks good, but we don't have a canonical sample of HSM syslogs in our pipeline. Can someone drop a 1-day sample (redacted) into s3://redwood-compliance/hsm-samples. Also confirm that auditlog forwarder is adding `key_id` and `operation` fields.

Alex P: Will drop sample by EOD. For forwarder fields, config is here: `configs/audit-forwarder.yml` — key snippet: `fields: [timestamp, key_id, operation, outcome]`. Quick curl to validate endpoint: `curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.internal/audit -d '{"key_id":"test","operation":"rotate"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'`

Jen L: Product/Compliance POV — we need owner assignments for each checklist item so auditors can ping directly. Proposal: Alex -> KMS infra & audit-forwarder, Samir -> audit evidence + attestation writeup, Jen -> compliance doc + export signoff, Maria -> program owner/overall timeline. Agree?

Tyler G: Small note — model key signing sits with eng-ml; we depend on KMS rotating without downtime during rollout. I'm happy to run integration tests once the mgmt network is open. Ping me when CA cert is in place.

Maria K: Sounds good. Assigning owners now: Alex=P, Samir=R, Jen=L, Tyler=G. Can each owner add a single-line status comment to the checklist doc: `docs/compliance/hsm-gate-checklist.md` by EOD Friday?

Alex P: Added entry and opened PR #7242 for the forwarder config + sample logs path. Marking CA cert as blocker in the doc.

Samir R: Drafted attestation skeleton in the doc and uploaded redacted syslog sample to s3 at `s3://redwood-compliance/hsm-samples/1939-sample.json`. Noted retention policy and checksum fields.

Jen L: I'll follow up with Legal on export-control signoff. Also looping in SOC2 audit contact — @AuditBot can you confirm required evidence format?

AuditBot: @Jen L Evidence format: JSONL events OR gzipped ndjson; minimum fields: `timestamp`, `identity`, `key_id`, `operation`, `outcome`. Delivery: s3 path + signed manifest. Deadline requested: 2 weeks before fieldwork.

sec-bot: Reminder: SOC2-fieldwork-deadline set for `2026-04-10` in the compliance calendar. Please surface all evidence earlier to avoid late churn. :calendar:

Alex P: CA cert vendor update: vendor legal said '2-3 business days' — ETA Wed. If it's later I'll request temporary exception with short-lived self-signed cert for staging only.

Tyler G: I'll start the model-signing e2e once the sample logs and rotation PR are merged. Can someone @me on the PR?

Maria K: @Tyler G — will do. Also, small risk: if CA cert slips past Wed, we need to escalate to Eng execs for a fast vendor check. Anyone opposed?

Samir R: +1 escalate if Wed misses. Also recommend we snapshot current keys and create a rollback plan doc in `docs/compliance/rollback-plan.md`. I can draft.

Jen L: I'll handle escalation path if needed. Adding legal and procurement to the doc comments.

Alex P: PR merged to staging for forwarder (after minor lint fix). Deployed to staging cluster `staging-audit-1`. Tests: `rotate->ingest->manifest` passed (CI run id: 20260308-88).

Maria K: Awesome. Closing loop: owners add final line to the checklist doc once production rollout window is scheduled. If anything blocks, please flag early. :thumbsup:

Tyler G: Thanks — pinged on PR and will run e2e after prod window scheduled.

AuditBot: Request logged: evidence delivery window expected by `2026-03-27`. Please confirm by next sync.

Maria K: Confirmed. Putting this on agenda for next week's async check-in. Thanks everyone.
